data: First mission to a metal-rich M-class asteroid
Added with /fly mission JSON (#341 batch 3 — sample-return pair). Spacecraft id 'psyche-spacecraft' to avoid colliding with the asteroid id 'psyche' (a DestinationId / small-body).
Psyche spacecraft — NASA (25 x 7.3 m arrays; bus 4.9 m incl. booms)

NASA's mission to a ~230-km M-type asteroid believed to be the exposed metal core of a differentiated proto-planet. Launched 2023-10-13 on a Falcon Heavy from Kennedy LC-39A; uses four SPT-140 Hall-effect ion thrusters as the primary cruise propulsion and a 2026 Mars gravity assist en route to a 2029 Psyche rendezvous. Carries a magnetometer, multispectral imager, and gamma-ray + neutron spectrometer.
First mission to a metal-rich M-class asteroid; first interplanetary spacecraft to use Hall-effect thrusters
First mission dedicated to characterising Europa's habitability
First mission to the Jupiter Trojans
Closest spacecraft to the Sun ever flown
Sample-returned Bennu (2023); now en route to Apophis
Mars atmospheric loss to solar wind
